label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Colonial’s 80th Schwab Challenge
items.text: Colonial Country Club hosts the Charles Schwab Challenge for its 80th consecutive year, rewarding precision with defending leader Ben Griffin seeking to match Ben Hogan’s rare Colonial title defense.

items.headline: Clark’s 60 Seals Byron Nelson Win
items.text: Wyndham Clark shot an 11-under 60 to win the CJ Cup Byron Nelson at 30-under 254, pulling away from Si Woo Kim and Scottie Scheffler for his fifth PGA Tour victory.

items.headline: Scheffler’s Frustration at Byron Nelson
items.text: Scottie Scheffler slammed his driver twice at the 13th tee during the CJ Cup Byron Nelson final round while four shots behind Clark, drawing fan ire despite finishing 25-under.
